title: Sample tool: sample settings
description: The settings of the sample tool: a small schema for the tests of rkmon_lib/settings_file.py.
x-header: These settings decide what one sample service does. GUIDE.md walks you through them, and README.md explains each one.
This file is yours: keep it out of git. Never put a password, token or key in it: sample login installs those.
Put text in double quotes. Replace every <...>, then run: sample check FILE

header: This service runs the queue by fixed rules. It writes no reviews, so it needs no tracker.

x-turn-on: To turn it on, see GUIDE.md, "Turn on a feature".

kind.description: The type of settings file. Don't change it.

schema_version.x-changed-by: sample migrate updates it when a new tool changes the layout
schema_version.description: The layout version of this file. Don't change it: sample migrate updates it when a new tool changes the layout.

service.title: Service
service.description: the service this file sets up.

name.description: The service's name. Lowercase letters, digits, - and _. Default: "sample".

tag.description: The release to run, such as "1.0.0". Required.

registry.x-blank: if you load the release from a file
registry.description: The registry to pull the release from, such as "registry.example.com/my-team". Leave blank if you load the release from a file.

host.title: Host
host.description: how much of this host the service may use.

cpus.description: The number of CPUs the service may use, from {minimum} to {maximum}. Default: 4.

user_id.x-default-means: your own user id on this host
user_id.description: The user id to run as, 1000 or more. Default: null, which means your own user id on this host.

share.description: The share of this host's memory the service may use, from {minimum} to {maximum}. Default: 0.5.

version.description: The tool's version, in quotes, such as "7.10". Leave blank for the newest release.

package_sha256.description: The package's SHA-256 checksum: 64 hex digits, in quotes. Leave blank to skip the check.

labels.description: The labels that put a pull request in scope. Example: ["my-project"]. Required.

folders.description: Labels that several teams share, each with a folder. Write each one as "label": "folder". Default: none.

features.title: Features
features.description:
what the service does. Each feature that posts has a mode:
  "prototype": it shows you its work, but posts nothing.
  "live": it posts.

reviews.title: Reviews
reviews.description: the service reviews each new pull request.

enabled.description: true: review pull requests. false: no reviews. Required.

mode.description: "prototype": reviews are shown to you, not posted. "live": reviews are posted. Required when reviews are on.

reviewer_name.description: The name at the top of each review. Leave blank to use the service's name.

effort.description: How hard the reviewer thinks: "low", "medium" or "high". Default: "high".

enabled.description: true: run the merge queue. false: no merge queue. Required.

mode.description: "prototype": the queue is shown to you. "live": the queue merges. Required when the queue is on.

notices.title: Notices
notices.description: a comment on each pull request near the front of the queue.

enabled.description: true: post them. false: none. Required when the queue is on.

every_minutes.description: Minutes between two updates of a notice, {minimum} or more. Default: 30.

page_url.description: The page the notices link to. Example: "https://dashboards.example.com/my-team/". Required when the queue is live. Otherwise, leave blank to link no page.

post_as.description: How a notice is posted: "comment" (a comment on the pull request) or "status" (a commit status). Default: "comment".

header.description: A line at the top of each comment. Leave blank for no header.

status.title: Status
status.description: use this block instead of comment when post_as is "status".

context.description: The status's name on the pull request. Default: "sample/queue".

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.description: the systems the service talks to.

tracker.title: Tracker
tracker.description: the issue tracker the reviews link to.

project.x-source: your tracker's project key, such as "SAMPLE"
project.description: The tracker's project key. Required when reviews are on.

address.description: The tracker's address. Example: "https://tracker.example.com". Leave blank for no links.

bindings.title: Bindings
bindings.description: other models the reviews can use, each under a name you choose. Default: none.

provider.description: "gateway": a model behind a gateway. Required.

api_key_secret_name.x-blank: for a gateway that takes no key
api_key_secret_name.description: The name of the secret that holds the gateway's key. Leave blank for a gateway that takes no key.

provider.description: "local": a model on this host. Required.

port.description: The port the model listens on. Required.
